meta.title: Smoothie
meta.author: Sigveseb (Ninjadev)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Smoothie by Ninjadev (2020-07-11). A 64K intro that placed 2nd in the combined 4k/64k intro competition at Solskogen 2020. Music credited to Sigveseb on Demozoo. 190 BPM, 2:16, 37 tracks, 3064 notes. Instruments: 4 Falcon (FM synth), 12 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 2 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 4 Scissor, 11 Leveller, 3 Echo, 5 Smasher, 3 Chamber, 2 Twister, 2 Cathedral. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.02 dB loudness and at most 0.48 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
